`create_model` computes `flat` and converts snapshots for `n.model.parameters`, but never converts `sns` itself: the variable and constraint builders still receive the original MultiIndex. The context changes component data representation, not the representation of the passed `sns`, so `"flat"` (and `"auto"` under v1 semantics) does not satisfy the criterion, regardless of transmission losses.
